description: This file provides utility functions to instantiate and configure a Supabase client for the application. It reads configuration parameters such as URL and API key from environment variables, and includes a feature toggle for enabling real-time capabilities.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured Supabase client instance, or null if necessary environment variables are missing.

methods.name: isRealtimeEnabled()
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if real-time features are enabled.
